_about: The Hermetic writings in English: John David Chambers's Theological and Philosophical Works of Hermes Trismegistus, translated from the Greek (T. & T. Clark, 1882), and John Everard's Divine Pymander (1650), in George Redway's 1884 reprint with Hargrave Jennings's introduction. Raw IA OCR. Not minted.

hermetica-chambers-1882: The Theological and Philosophical Works of Hermes Trismegistus, Christian Neoplatonist, translated from the original Greek, with preface, notes and indices (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1882)
hermetica-everard-pymander-1884: The Divine Pymander of Hermes Mercurius Trismegistus (Everard's translation of 1650; London: George Redway, 1884, with an introduction by Hargrave Jennings)
